message: Align Swiss Grid design system across all surfaces and add scroll reveals (v1.8.23)
changelog: Locked Desktop Extension Popup Dimensions Across All Menus (src/popup/styles/02-base.css, src/popup/styles/05-modals-weights.css): Scoped < 480px mobile popup responsiveness strictly to touch screens ((max-width: 479px) and (pointer: coarse)), locked html min/max height to 600px, and gave .popup-views-scroll and .view-panel explicit width: 100% so desktop popups never shrink horizontally or vertically when switching to Finance/Payments or any other tab.

Persistent Drafts When Adding or Editing Financial Deadlines (src/popup/popupDraft.ts, src/popup/modules/paymentsView.ts, src/popup/modules/navigation.ts): Closing the extension while adding or editing an item inside #modal-payment now preserves the open modal, edit target ID, and all unsaved form fields across reopens identically to academic deadlines.
